summary: Silgan Holdings filed an 8-K to announce a routine quarterly cash dividend of $0.21 per share, payable June 15, 2026 to holders of record on June 1, 2026. This is a standard capital allocation action by the board, not a special situation event. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, or other extraordinary corporate transaction. The filing contains no deal terms, advisor involvement, or unusual structural features. The dividend represents the company's eighty-ninth consecutive quarterly payment and is a routine, scheduled return of capital to shareholders.
